story: Nifty 50 opened at 24,518, flat from the previous close of 24,537.
The index dipped to a low of 24,388 (-0.61%) around 9:15 AM and touched a high of 25,030 (+2.01%) around 3:30 PM.
It settled at 25,030 (+2.01%), near the top of the day's range, so buyers held control into the close.
41 of the 50 Nifty stocks advanced and 8 declined; Bank Nifty outperformed (+2.27%).
Latest institutional data (05 Nov): FII/FPI net +14975 Cr, DII net -10445 Cr.
risks: Markets stay shut until Monday (3 days): weekend news, geopolitics and any Wall Street or Asian moves will all be priced in at the open.
Wall Street trades through tonight (from about 7:00 PM IST); the S&P 500 last closed at 7,353.73 (-4.36%), so US data and Fed commentary can swing the opening.
Brent crude is at US$98.09 (-0.20%); no sharp move so far, but it is a swing factor for inflation and the rupee.
Currency and yields to track: USD/INR 93.900 (-0.65%), US 10-year yield 4.84% (-1.16%). A firmer dollar or higher US yields usually weigh on foreign flows.
GIFT Nifty keeps trading into the late evening, now 24,951.0 (-0.32% vs Nifty's close): the best live read on the next opening.
